data.name: Ninja Man - Land Of The Rising Sun
data.detailed_description:
Ninja Man takes place in an old feudal Japanese time period with a mixture of Chinese & future tech mixed into the environments. This future tech comes from a twist in the plot of the story, that you will experience as you play through the game.

 

You play as Ninja Man a who was washed up on a beach as a child from the African slave trade boats found on Gou (ゴウ) Island by the locals and raised by the Japanese & Chinese traditions, teachings and combat. In Ninja Man - Land Of The Rising Sun you play through a open world where you can craft, build fish, swim and fight your way through the open world. Moving freely area to area buying new clothes, weapons, items and farming for items and materials to help you craft the items or weapons you need.

Overall Ninja Man - Land Of The Rising Sun, Is a very ambitious action adventure game, bringing back the gameplay and element's of gaming that's been lost over the years, focusing on the content and adding more to the experience of the player. Later on in the build of the game you can play solo through the different game modes or the open world or you can play with a friend in a Co-Op adventure doing everything from the mini game modes to the open world together.

data.short_description: Ninja Man - Land Of The Rising Sun, Is a 2D platform / side scrolling - open world adventure game filled with mini adventures, beautiful environments, and elements that give the classic feel of gaming. This game is a tribute to the old classics with a Japanese/Chinese and future mix.
